competing_explanation: The claim may reflect an outdated policy, a promotional exception, or a misreading of a non-standard item policy.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Any authoritative current policy source states a different return window, a different start point such as purchase date instead of delivery date, or does not provide a full refund for standard items within 30 days.
